summary: Configured node1 so only members of the local `remote-access` group may log in through SSH. Created the previously absent `opsadmin` account, added it to the group, and verified the policy persists across a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created `remote-access` and `opsadmin`, then added `opsadmin` as a supplementary group member.
Verified through real SSH connections to the managed IP that `opsadmin` succeeds while a credentialed non-member is denied.
Removed all temporary test credentials and the probe account.
Safely rebooted node1 and repeated service, configuration, identity, and behavioral checks.

evidence.requirement: `opsadmin` is a member of local group `remote-access`
evidence.summary: Initial creation and final post-reboot state both show `opsadmin` in `remote-access`.

evidence.requirement: SSH login is restricted to members of `remote-access`
evidence.summary: Shows the validated effective `AllowGroups remote-access` policy and successful behavioral tests: `opsadmin` connected while a credentialed non-member was rejected, both before and after reboot.

Captures the healthy baseline, acknowledged native reboot, boot-ID change from e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7 to 32b88061-15b9-4001-9992-1d1f0a620fad, recovered SSH listener and managed-IP handshake, persisted account/group data, and post-reboot allow/deny behavior.
Confirms removal of temporary probe accounts, keys, and trackers while retaining the required final policy and membership.
